PP2 · Chapter 5 of 7

Find the pattern

Repeat a group, fill a gap and predict a growing picture.

  1. See it
  2. Try it
  3. Practise it
  4. Print it
  5. Check it

This chapter works best after Long, heavy and full. You can still look around, or jump to the check.

By the end I can…

  • I can continue a repeating group.
  • I can fill a gap in a pattern.
  • I can spot a broken rule.

1 See it

Screen 1 of 4

Repeat the group

Star, star, heart.

The same group again and again.

Say it as you point.

Screen 2 of 4

Fill the gap

Ball, apple, ball, apple.

One picture is missing.

It is a ball.

Screen 3 of 4

A broken rule

Star, heart, star, heart.

Then a ball. That breaks the rule.

A heart should be there.

Screen 4 of 4

A picture that grows

Row 1 has 2. Row 2 has 2 more.

Now there are 4. Row 3 makes 6.

It grows by 2 each time.

Words to know
pattern
A group of pictures that repeats.
gap
A missing spot in a pattern.
rule
What the pattern does each time.

For parents

What your child learns

Your child continues a repeating pattern, fills a gap, and spots a picture that breaks the rule. Growing patterns lead to number rules later.

A common slip

Guessing a gap without saying the whole group. Say the pattern from the start every time.

5-minute home activity: Clap and stamp

  1. Clap, clap, stamp. Clap, clap, stamp.
  2. Ask your child to carry on.
  3. Make a mistake on purpose. Ask, "What went wrong?"
  4. Draw a colour pattern and cover one part.
